mapper.sql: select t.trigger_id, t.trigger_name, t.trigger_type, t.event_type, cast(t.event_filter as text) as event_filter, t.cron_expression, t.playbook_id, p.playbook_code, t.agent_code, t.action, cast(t.params as text) as params, t.delay_minutes, t.ttl_hours, t.max_attempts, t.last_fire_time, t.status, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark from abr_growth_trigger t left join abr_playbook p on p.playbook_id = t.playbook_id
mapper.insert: insert into abr_growth_trigger (trigger_name, trigger_type, event_type, event_filter, cron_expression, playbook_id, agent_code, action, params, delay_minutes, ttl_hours, max_attempts, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{triggerName}, #{triggerType}, #{eventType}, cast(coalesce(#{eventFilter}, '{}') as jsonb), #{cronExpression}, #{playbookId}, #{agentCode}, #{action}, cast(coalesce(#{actionParams}, '{}') as jsonb), coalesce(#{delayMinutes}, 0), coalesce(#{ttlHours}, 72), coalesce(#{maxAttempts}, 3), coalesce(#{status}, '0'), #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update abr_growth_trigger set trigger_name = #{triggerName}, trigger_type = #{triggerType}, event_type = #{eventType}, event_filter = cast(coalesce(#{eventFilter}, '{}') as jsonb), last_fire_time = case when cron_expression is distinct from #{cronExpression} or trigger_type <> #{triggerType} then null else last_fire_time end, cron_expression = #{cronExpression}, playbook_id = #{playbookId}, agent_code = #{agentCode}, action = #{action}, params = cast(coalesce(#{actionParams}, '{}') as jsonb), delay_minutes = coalesce(#{delayMinutes}, 0), ttl_hours = coalesce(#{ttlHours}, 72), max_attempts = coalesce(#{maxAttempts}, 3), status = coalesce(#{status}, '0'), remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where trigger_id = #{triggerId}
